ground_truth_method: hand-curated from transformers v5.6.2 source (pip wheel 5.6.2, source-only) plus huggingface_hub.constants pass-through (carried from v4.57.3 GT, version-pinned to huggingface_hub not transformers)
ground_truth_reviewer_check: every entry has source.file + source.line; verify by opening the file at that line in the v5.6.2 tag (github.com/huggingface/transformers/blob/v5.6.2/src/...)

pretrained_model_name_or_path.description: Model id, local dir, or None (when state_dict + config supplied).

config.description: Note: class renamed PretrainedConfig -> PreTrainedConfig in v5.

weights_only.description: Now an explicit keyword in the v5 signature (was a kwargs.pop in v4.57.3).

fusion_config.description: NEW in v5: dict[str, bool | dict] controlling module fusion. Promoted to explicit signature.

disable_mmap.description: NEW in v5: disables memory-mapped safetensors loading. Promoted to explicit signature.

state_dict.description: Override of state_dict to use instead of loading from the checkpoint.

tqdm_class.description: NEW kwarg in v5: custom tqdm progress-bar class forwarded to the checkpoint resolver.

_from_pipeline.description: Internal: pipeline source tag (added to user_agent telemetry).

_from_auto.description: Internal: signals call came from Auto* class.

dtype.description: Canonical name. In v5 the resolved default is 'auto' (line 4014-4015: if dtype is None -> 'auto'), a behavioural change from v4.57.3 where the unresolved default was None.

torch_dtype.description: Deprecated; aliased to dtype (comment 'kept for BC'). If both supplied, dtype wins.

device_map.description: v5 routes device_map through check_and_set_device_map() in integrations/accelerate.py. Same four named strings OR a torch device spec. Int -> {'': N}. Negative int raises. Requires accelerate.

_commit_hash.description: Internal: short-circuits hash resolution if known.

adapter_kwargs.description: PEFT adapter loader kwargs (LoRA / IA3 etc.). Empty dict by default.

generation_config.description: Override of the model's bundled generation config.

gguf_file.description: Path to a GGUF checkpoint. Mutually exclusive with quantization_config and with disk-offload device_map. Requires accelerate.

tp_plan.description: v5: now accepts a dict[str, str] plan OR 'auto' (no longer 'auto'-only). Mutually exclusive with device_map. Requires torch>=2.5.

tp_size.description: Tensor parallel degree. Raises if set without tp_plan.

distributed_config.description: DistributedConfig instance. If set, forces tp_plan='auto'.

device_mesh.description: torch.distributed.DeviceMesh. If >1D must contain a 'tp' dim.

allow_all_kernels.description: NEW kwarg in v5: relaxes the HF kernel-hub allowlist when use_kernels is on.

use_kernels.description: Opt-in path to HF kernel-hub attention kernels. Auto-forced True if kernel_config is set (with warning).

kernel_config.description: NEW kwarg in v5: explicit kernel-hub kernel mapping. Setting it auto-enables use_kernels with a warning_once.

key_mapping.description: Optional state-dict key rename map; auto-applied for VLM classes when None.

attn_implementation.description: Set on config via config._attn_implementation. Plus any registered ALL_ATTENTION_FUNCTIONS key; plus HF kernel-hub repo specs.

experts_implementation.description: NEW in v5: MoE experts kernel selection. Set on config via config._experts_implementation (parallel to attn_implementation).

code_revision.description: Git revision for the trust_remote_code modeling repo (separate from `revision`).

mirror.description: v5: silently popped no-op. Part of the dead-kwargs sweep at line 4008 ('Not used anymore -- remove them from the kwargs').

_fast_init.description: v5: silently popped no-op (dead-kwargs sweep line 4008).

low_cpu_mem_usage.description: v5: silently popped no-op (dead-kwargs sweep line 4008). Lazy-init is always-on. Accepted but dead.

from_tf.description: v5: silently popped no-op (dead-kwargs sweep line 4008). TF loading removed; kwarg accepted but dead. In v4.57.3 it actually selected the TF loader.

from_flax.description: v5: silently popped no-op (dead-kwargs sweep line 4008). Flax loading removed; kwarg accepted but dead.

offload_state_dict.description: v5: silently popped no-op (dead-kwargs sweep line 4008).

sampling_params._NOTE_v5_default_refactor: BREAKING v5 CHANGE: every GenerationConfig field defaults to None in __init__ (kwargs.pop(name, None)). The effective defaults shown below live in GenerationConfig._get_default_generation_params() (line 551) and are applied lazily at generate-time, NOT in __init__. The 'default' values below are the EFFECTIVE defaults from _get_default_generation_params(); the literal __init__ default is None for all fields. This decouples 'what the config object holds' from 'what generate() uses'.

top_h.description: NEW in v5: top-H (entropy-based) sampling control. Greedy-strip dormant warning at validate line 652.

watermarking_config.description: If a BaseWatermarkingConfig instance, kept as-is; .validate() delegated in GenerationConfig.validate.

is_assistant.description: v5: now a regular kwargs.pop (was hard-coded False in v4.57.3). Effective default still falsey.

continuous_batching_config.description: NEW in v5: ContinuousBatchingConfig dataclass for generate_batch / continuous-batching context manager. NOT validated inside GenerationConfig.validate().

low_memory.description: Deprecated; scheduled for removal in v4.62.0 (note retained in v5 source).

_removed_sampling_params_vs_v4_57_3.return_legacy_cache: REMOVED in v5. Was a kwargs.pop field + cache-strip arm of validate() in v4.57.3 (line 352). No longer present in __init__ or validate.

cache_classes._NOTE_v5_refactor: BREAKING v5 CHANGE: the monolithic Cache taxonomy was rearchitected into a layer-mixin composition model. Top-level Cache classes reduced from 13 (v4.57.3) to 4. Per-layer behaviour now lives in CacheLayerMixin subclasses. SlidingWindowCache is a deprecated alias of StaticCache (line 1574). HybridCache, HybridChunkedCache, OffloadedCache, OffloadedStaticCache, OffloadedHybridCache, SinkCache, MambaCache, QuantoQuantizedCache, HQQQuantizedCache removed as top-level classes.

env_vars._NOTE_v5_hub_simplification: BREAKING v5 CHANGE: transformers/utils/hub.py was slimmed from 1162 LOC to 949. The transformers-owned legacy cache/endpoint env-var reads were removed: TRANSFORMERS_CACHE, PYTORCH_TRANSFORMERS_CACHE, PYTORCH_PRETRAINED_BERT_CACHE, HUGGINGFACE_CO_RESOLVE_ENDPOINT, HUGGINGFACE_CO_STAGING, TORCH_HOME, XDG_CACHE_HOME. is_offline_mode is now imported directly from huggingface_hub (line 40), so the transformers-local _is_offline_mode import-time binding AND the TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE read are GONE. Offline gating is fully delegated to huggingface_hub.constants.HF_HUB_OFFLINE.

HF_MODULES_CACHE.behavior: Where dynamic (trust_remote_code) module source files are cached.

TRANSFORMERS_VERBOSITY.behavior: Override of default logger level. 'detail' enables DEBUG with filename+lineno. Unknown value logs an error and falls through to default WARNING.

CI.behavior: NEW read in v5 logging: if set, tweaks logger flush behaviour for CI environments.

TRANSFORMERS_IS_CI.behavior: If truthy (ENV_VARS_TRUE_VALUES), suppresses Hub telemetry user-agent enrichment.

ECS_CONTAINER_METADATA_URI.behavior: AWS ECS telemetry probe for user-agent enrichment.

SM_FRAMEWORK_PARAMS.behavior: SageMaker framework params (JSON) for telemetry user-agent.

TRUST_REMOTE_CODE.behavior: Legacy env var checked by RAG / RealmRetriever / TransfoXL tokenizer paths to short-circuit the trust_remote_code prompt. NOT used by the modern AutoClass.from_pretrained path.

WORLD_SIZE.behavior: If set and >0 while device_map='auto', logger.info warns about distributed-vs-auto interaction.

LOCAL_RANK.behavior: Used by initialize_tensor_parallelism to set the local accelerator device when tp_plan is set.

RANK.behavior: NEW dependency surface in v5: read by initialize_tensor_parallelism to init the process group for tp_plan.

HF_HOME.behavior: Root of HF cache hierarchy. In v5 this is the only cache root (legacy TRANSFORMERS_CACHE removed).

HF_TOKEN.behavior: Bearer token for authenticated requests. Read when token kwarg is None.

HF_HUB_OFFLINE.behavior: If truthy, forces local_files_only=True. In v5 transformers calls huggingface_hub.is_offline_mode() directly (imported at hub.py:40), so the v4.57.3 transformers-local import-time-binding gotcha NO LONGER applies in transformers itself; the binding semantics are now whatever huggingface_hub does. is_offline_mode() is consulted at from_pretrained line 4017.

HF_ENDPOINT.behavior: Base URL for Hub API/file resolution. v5 reads it via constants.ENDPOINT (no transformers-local HUGGINGFACE_CO_RESOLVE_ENDPOINT shim).

HF_HUB_DISABLE_TELEMETRY.behavior: If True, transformers omits the X-User-Agent telemetry suffix.

HF_HUB_DISABLE_IMPLICIT_TOKEN.behavior: Disables automatic token resolution from cached login.

HF_HUB_ENABLE_HF_TRANSFER.behavior: Opt-in to hf_transfer accelerated downloads; requires hf_transfer pkg.

_removed_env_vars_vs_v4_57_3.TRANSFORMERS_CACHE: REMOVED from transformers/utils/hub.py in v5. Use HF_HOME.
_removed_env_vars_vs_v4_57_3.XDG_CACHE_HOME: No longer read directly by transformers.utils.hub (still used inside huggingface_hub HF_HOME resolution).
_removed_env_vars_vs_v4_57_3.TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE: No longer read by transformers in v5. Offline gating is fully delegated to huggingface_hub.constants.HF_HUB_OFFLINE via the imported is_offline_mode().

pipeline_kwargs._NOTE_v5: v5 dropped the `framework` kwarg from the pipeline() signature (was 'pt'/'tf'/None in v4.57.3; TF support removed). 16 explicit keyword params now (was 17). The real impl is at line 440; lines 383-431 are typed @overload stubs.

dtype.description: pipeline() defaults to 'auto'. (from_pretrained now ALSO resolves None->'auto' in v5, so the v4.57.3 divergence is closed.)

ContinuousBatchingConfig._note: NEW dataclass in v5. 19 fields. Drives generate_batch / continuous_batching_context_manager. Not validated in GenerationConfig.validate().

bnb_4bit_compute_dtype.description: Init signature default None; resolved to torch.float32.

GPTQConfig._note: v5 deltas: NEW field act_group_aware (default True; auto-disabled when desc_act=True). checkpoint_format RENAMED to format (legacy key still accepted via kwargs). REMOVED fields: use_exllama, use_cuda_fp16, exllama_config.

act_group_aware.description: NEW in v5. GAR group-aware activation order. Forced to False when desc_act=True (with warning).

format.description: RENAMED from checkpoint_format. Lowercased. 'gptq' (v1) or 'gptq_v2'. Legacy checkpoint_format kwarg still honoured.

AwqConfig._note: BREAKING v5 rework: AwqConfig now SUBCLASSES GPTQConfig. The `version` field was replaced by `format` (AwqFormat enum), and `backend` is now an AwqBackend enum. REMOVED fields: version (legacy key still accepted), do_fuse, fuse_max_seq_len, modules_to_fuse, exllama_config. zero_point and modules_to_not_convert retained; inherits GPTQConfig fields.

backend.description: AwqBackend enum. Legacy 'autoawq' coerced to 'auto'. 'llm-awq' value re-routes to format=LLM_AWQ + backend=auto in post_init.

format.description: AwqFormat enum (replaces legacy `version`). Legacy `version` kwarg lowercased into format.

AutoRoundConfig._note: Field surface unchanged from v4.57.3 (packing_format set internally).

CompressedTensorsConfig._note: v5: constructor now eagerly imports compressed_tensors and model_validate's the nested config; run_compressed is the primary user knob. Field surface effectively reduced to the loader-facing attrs.

group_size.description: hadamard_size must be divisible by group_size.

FPQuantConfig._note: v5 delta: backward_dtype now allows ['bf16', 'mxfp8', 'mxfp4'] (was bf16-only). Cross-field: non-bf16 backward only valid with mxfp4 forward.

hadamard_group_size.description: Resolves to 16 (nvfp4) or 32 (mxfp4) when None. Allowed sets differ per forward_dtype.

FineGrainedFP8Config._note: v5 deltas: NEW field dequantize. activation_scheme enum widened to ['dynamic', 'static'] (was dynamic-only). quant_method is now QuantizationMethod.FP8.

weight_block_size.description: Must be a tuple/list of length 2 with positive entries.

dequantize.description: NEW in v5: dequantize the model during loading.

quant_method.description: Required key; values like 'fp8' or 'awq' route to legacy parser.

MetalConfig._note: NEW in v5: Apple Silicon (MPS) affine quantization via mlx-quantization-metal-kernels.

FourOverSixConfig._note: NEW in v5: 'Four Over Six' adaptive NVFP4 quantization (arxiv 2512.02010). No post_init validators (free-form string fields).

SinqConfig._note: NEW in v5: SINQ / A-SINQ weight-only quantization.

group_size.description: Should be a multiple of 8 (warning otherwise).
